[assistant] - [Critical] .claude/settings.local.json:43 — `Bash(git *)` broadly allows destructive git operations such as `clean`, `reset`, and checkout variants, undermining the deny list.
- [High] .claude/settings.local.json:48 — `Bash(codex exec *)` grants unrestricted nested agent command execution, which can bypass the intended command allowlist.
- [High] .claude/settings.local.json:127 — hook commands hard-code `/Users/hoon/workTree/agent-factory`, so hooks silently fail when the repo is cloned or run from another workspace.
- [Medium] .claude/settings.local.json:66 — `Bash(pip3 install *)` allows arbitrary package installation from untrusted sources, creating a supply-chain execution path.
- [Medium] core/skill_quality_gate.py:52 — knowledge skills are auto-registered as `active` solely from `SKILL.md` presence, with no validation that `meta.yaml` describes a valid/safe skill contract.
